lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 4-5 horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters distributed in a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank, extending from the posterior gills to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal blob rows, forming a coordinate-like lattice where blobs serve as nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges on the upper flank exhibit a distinct vertical luminance gradient, with light-intensity upper edges transitioning to high-contrast shadow regions immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate distribution of high-luminance blobs within the first dorsal fin silhouette, primarily clustered along the posterior margin and ventral base.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly concentrated and irregularly sized high-luminance blobs are visible across the entire surface of the right pectoral fin, showing higher density than the adjacent flank.
